Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade one
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.2: Sign reading 11.2.2 Comprehension
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign reading 11.2.2 Comprehension, part of Strand 11 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade one General.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign reading 11.2.2 Comprehension together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Creativity and Imagination: The learner explores as they predict what will happen in a story based on the title and the pictures.

Values:
Respect: patience is developed as the learner displays patience with each other as they take turns in reading.
